sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, sitting top with 34 points from 16 games, face Shawbury United at home on Saturday 21 November. Sandbach are in solid form, having won their most recent fixture and secured three wins in their last six league matches, though they've also suffered two losses in that run. Shawbury arrive with recent momentum of their own, having won two of their last six league games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, level on 34 points with Sandbach but with a game in hand, will be watching closely as the title race intensifies. In Saturday's fixtures, Eccleshall (3rd, 31pts) and Bilston Town (4th, 30pts) are not in action this week, but several mid-table sides have opportunities: Stafford Town host Market Drayton Town in a clash between 6th and 14th; AFC Bridgnorth (5th, 30pts) welcome Wednesfield Community (16th, 16pts); and Crewe face Cheadle Heath Nomads in a fixture between 17th and 12th. Alsager Town (18th, 11pts) visit New Mills (10th, 21pts) on Saturday before hosting in-form Barnton (8th, 25pts) on Tuesday evening in a potential trouble-maker fixture for the struggling hosts. Widnes Town (20th, 8pts) travel to in-form Allscott Heath (7th, 26pts), while Foley Meir (15th) host Dawley Town (9th, 22pts). Brereton Social (13th, 18pts) visit Widnes Town on Saturday.
